thread:
mina: heads-up: q4 bring-up for nebula-x on staging showing systematic quality regressions on our short-context multilingual suite (ja / zh-Hant / ko). small repro + example below. anyone seen tokenizer splits like this after quant builds?

mina: repro command:
```
./eval_shortctx --model=nebula-x --quant=q4 --locales=ja,zh-Hant,ko \ 
  --dataset=shortctx-2026 --metrics=bleu,chrf --seed=42 --batch=64
```

mina: quick diff (float32 -> q4):
```
locale   float32_bleu  q4_bleu   float32_chrf  q4_chrf
ja       32.1          27.9      49.8          44.6
zh-Hant  28.4          24.5      45.1          40.2
ko       30.2          27.0      47.0          43.3
```

mina: failing example (ja):
src: "吾輩は猫である。"
ref: 吾輩は猫である。
q4_out: 吾輩は である。  (missing 猫 token, extra space)

oliver: that looks like a tokenization boundary/split issue rather than decoder hallucination. did the tokenizer binary change between artifact builds?

cheng: ran tokenize-debug on both artifacts, difference: 
```
float32 tokenize("吾輩は猫である。") -> ["吾輩","\u306f","\u732b","\u3067","\u3042\u308b","\u3002"]
q4 tokenize("吾輩は猫である。")   -> ["吾","\u8f29","\u306f","","\u732b","\u3067","\u3042\u308b","\u3002"]
```
cheng: see the empty token and an extra split between 吾 and 輩. that would lead to a missing token after the model decodes and we detokenize.

sato: we rolled unified-split v2 into tokenizers/ja last week (commit abc1234) to fix ruby/kanbun edgecases. possible packaging mismatch with the q4 build?

mina: staging q4 artifact: nebula-x:q4-2026-03-18, float artifact: nebula-x:float-2026-03-19. i'll inspect the tokenizer hash embedded in the model bundles.

cheng: also saw similar splits in zh-Hant when ideographic space/ZWJ combos are present. worth checking zero-width handling across quantized kernels. i can run a quick bisect across tokenizer releases.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment updated: rollout_id=rl-2026-1770, hosts=3/3 updated, metadata: tokenizers/hash: 1a2b3c -> 2b3c4d. Use `deploy-bot logs rl-2026-1770` to view details.

oliver: short-term mitigation idea: add a detok post-filter that collapses empty tokens and strips stray zero-width spaces before scoring. ugly but could recover metrics for the canary while we fix packaging.

sato: if packaging is wrong we should hotfix model bundler to embed tokenizer runtime deterministic checksum and fail deploys when mismatched.

mina: i'm creating a minimal reproducer + GH issue with failing samples, tokenize logs, and eval diffs. i'll try the detok filter on the canary and report new numbers here.

oliver: thanks — ping when you have the reproducer. also include a couple of zh-Hant vertical punctuation examples; those behaved oddly in my local smoke tests earlier.
